newsitem.title: USA: Seaplane crashes on New Hampshire highway.
newsitem.headline: Seaplane crashes on New Hampshire highway.

text.p: A small seaplane with one person aboard crashed Wednesday on Interstate 89 near the New Hampshire-Vermont border in West Lebanon, New Hampshire.

Lebanon police said the plane went down shortly after 12:30 p.m. EDT and an unidentified man was taken from the wreckage to a local hospital. The pilot's medical condition was not known, a police dispatcher said.
Eyewitnesses said the aircraft, equipped with pontoons, had just taken off from Lebanon Airport when it developed engine trouble, lost power and disappeared from sight.
The pilot tried an emergency landing on the southbound lane of the busy highway but the plane flipped over, witnesses said. Police said no one else was injured in the accident.
The highway remained closed in both directions as officials cleared wreckage.
